描述_EN: the first corgi diecast models were made by mettoy in 1956, and were marketed as 'the ones with windows'. the other vehicles in the range included a routemaster bus, a mini, the concorde and a tube train. its official authenticitywais guaranteed by a holographic sticker on the reverse. it was produced as part of the corgi product range, in a presentation box emblazoned with london 2012 logos and featuring 'did you know?' facts, designed to appeal to children and adult collectors. this tx1, first seen on the streets of london in 1997, features not only windows, but also olympic number plates and a detailed moulded chassis. this diecast black cab is one of a series of 'great british classics' produced by hornby hobbies ltd in run up to the 2012 olympic games.
描述_ZN: 第一个corgi压铸模型是由mettoy在1956年制造的，并被销售为 "有窗户的"。 该系列中的其他车辆包括一辆Routemaster巴士、一辆迷你车、Concorde和一辆地铁列车。 其官方真实性是由背面的全息贴纸保证的。 它是作为corgi产品系列的一部分生产的，装在一个印有2012年伦敦奥运会标志的盒子里，并有 "你知道吗？"的事实，旨在吸引儿童和成人收藏家。 这个T1，1997年首次出现在伦敦的街道上，不仅有窗户，还有奥运会的号码牌和一个详细的模具底盘。 这个压铸的黑色出租车是由HORNBY Hobbies LTD在2012年奥林匹克运动会之前生产的 "伟大的英国经典 "系列之一。
